probeCards.result: Root family archive/format zip, not vector/shapefile_zip. Grouped .shp child is vector/shapefile, geometry types/native extent from header, feature count from .shx length if present and rows from .dbf header. CRS sidecar with null code and .prj hash, never resolved by probe; EPSG:4326 extent null. Companions grouped into child, no extracted original. Root count.features null. ZIP bounds may leave members unprobed with refusal codes.

SQLite magic plus GPKG application id identifies family vector/format geopackage; no SQLite tables opened by this probe. Signature depth, CRS absent/null, count.features null, both extents null, no layers. Without that application id it is sqlite/table, not guessed from .gpkg extension.

Root kml identifies vector/kml at signature depth; CRS absent/null, feature count and extent unknown. The probe does not infer WGS84 from XML or parse placemarks; separate native reader does more. KMZ members change root to vector/kmz (intake-zip.ts:189-193).

If retained through uploads: vector/geojson, structure depth, sampled geometry types/columns only. Whole-file count unknown because only bounded head is read. CRS stated only from a literal header declaration (code may be null), bbox only if literal metadata is present before features; no assumption or whole-file bounds computation. Receipt metadata can supply cited counts/CRS; no manual receipt exists for a >16 MiB file. Size class M.

readers.sequence: Zero-based position in original FeatureCollection.features, before quarantine; stable for exact bytes. Mapping idField reads properties[field], then stringifies validated scalar; absent/empty/duplicate keys are fatal, no invented keys.

Selected .shp/.dbf sequence from pyshp iterShapeRecords; zero-based enumerate index in intermediate ArcGIS features. Complete matching counts and no deleted/missing records are required. Under these conditions index N corresponds to the N+1th physical record, stable for exact bytes and same reader. It is not the literal SHP header's record-number field, which is not carried into the feature.
readers.limits: 1 byte-16 MiB container (_raw:27-37); <=1000 ZIP members, <=64 MiB expanded (:173-175), 1-100 .shp sets (:190-202). Multiple sets require layer selection, otherwise AREA_PROCESSING; single set inferred. Matching .shp/.shx/.dbf/.prj, resolvable EPSG, supported .cpg/default UTF-8, strict 2D and 1-2000 matching records (:202-224). Unsafe paths, duplicates, symlinks/encryption refused. idField must name a present selected DBF field; adapter supplies no fallback feature.id.

readers.sequence: Zero-based index in SELECT geometry+selected columns FROM selected_table LIMIT 2001; there is NO ORDER BY at native_gis.py:128. Current ordinary table scan commonly follows rowid, but code does not promise rowid ordering or record it. Same bytes/reader can replay in the present SQLite scan; durable citation must not claim a governed rowid-order guarantee. It needs an explicit stable row locator/ordering before binary exact-citation support.
readers.limits: 1 byte-16 MiB container; 1-100 feature layers (:88-104), single layer inferred, multi-layer requires explicit selection. One materialized nonvirtual strictly 2D geometry table, valid agreeing EPSG/WKT, <=2000 rows, 100000 vertices, five-second SQLite progress deadline (:105-163). idField reads selected table column; absent column or incomplete/duplicate keys refused, no adapter feature.id.
